rationale: Superintelligence most likely arrives in the 2030s to 2040s, and since AI makes up most of doom and a large share of level 4, those tails are front-loaded, playing out within roughly five to ten years of deployment, so about 60% of doom risk is realised by 2050. Level 3 catastrophes are spread more evenly across the century: wars, civil breakdown and pandemics strike at a roughly constant rate, while climate and resource limits build up and weigh more after 2050, which keeps level 3 close to a uniform-hazard path, at about 16% by 2050 and 30% by 2075.
